speaker: Doctor
text: Mr. Patient, I understand you're feeling agitated, but I need to ask you directly: have you been hearing or seeing things that others don't? Also, please tell me if you have used any illicit substances recently.

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any changes in your sleep patterns, such as significantly reduced need for sleep, or have you been hearing voices commanding you to perform specific actions?

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the duration of symptoms and the nature of his delusions, I need to rule out organic causes. REQUEST TEST: Urine Drug Screen. REQUEST TEST: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel.
